template.name: LuckPerms
template.description: Advanced permissions plugin for Bukkit, Spigot, and Paper servers. Installs LuckPerms 5.5.71 and writes a clean starter configuration.

variables.label: Server Name
variables.description: Identifier for this server when using context-specific permissions across a network.

variables.label: Storage Method
variables.description: Database or file format used to store permissions data.

variables.label: Allow Invalid Usernames
variables.description: Allow usernames containing characters outside standard Java rules (helpful with Floodgate).

variables.label: Enable Auto-OP
variables.description: Automatically grant OP status to players who hold the luckperms.autoop permission.

steps.name: Write LuckPerms configuration
